messages:
sasha: Heads-up - forwarder flagged 10 units (PO RW-2026-621) detained at FRA due to commercial invoice serial mismatch. Were blocked for a scheduled NL cluster top-off tomorrow morning. :grimacing:
rick: can we split the AWB and air-express the confirmed serials? need to avoid degraded infra in NL.
sasha: AWB 555-1112223, forwarder sent `manifest_partial.csv` - several SNs truncated. attaching snippet.
laura-depot: NL depot can intake up to 8 units by next-day if flown in. we need clean AWB and customs docs or depot will refuse. SLA target 24-48h.
vendor-chen: we can do a split AWB same-day for up to 8 good units. expedited freight + customs paperwork is EUR 1,350. we'll issue a corrected commercial invoice and notarized serial list within 18h. Remaining 2 units will require FRA inspection -> potential RMA.
sasha: cost ok from ops buffer?
finance-bot: ops buffer has EUR 3,100 remaining this quarter. pre-approve expedite spend up to EUR 1,500. ticket FIN-10011 created.
ops-bot: created OPS ticket OPS-8412 to track AWB split, payment, and FRA inspection. Link: https://redwood-internal/ops/OPS-8412 :white_check_mark:
rick: please push vendor to confirm insurer contact for the 2 units with mismatch (possible DOA). Also ask FRA to photo-evidence thermal labels if present.
vendor-chen: confirming insurer rep and FRA inspection path. AWB split will be 555-1112223-A (8 expedited) and -B (held). I'll upload docs to OPS-8412 when available.
sasha: thanks. rick, laura - please stand by for AWB arrival ETA and mark nodes for warm-spare swap until replacements staged. will close when notarized invoice is attached. :thumbsup:
